content.rendered:
Fun Run Helpful Information and Reminders

The Hawks View Fun will take place on Friday, September 26th.  This is our largest fundraiser of the year and we appreciate your support! Let’s see if we can beat last year’s goal!   Fundraising closes October 3, 2025. We are looking forward to this fun event!

Fun Run Flyer

Fun Run Flyer Spanish

Please be sure your child is dressed appropriately for the weather, this is a rain or shine event.  Wear layers, no open toe shoes, no crocs, etc.  Don’t forget sunscreen and water bottles!  

All volunteers will need an approved background check before volunteering.  Background checks take 7-10 business days to clear.
